pool.source: the pool_cents parameter of the live sheet of the panel capacity workbook

tie_group.depth: the tie_group_depth clause of the appeals procedure memorandum
tie_group.rule: players adjacent in the standings and equal on every ordering key up to the depth form one group

group_amount.rule: the pool multiplied by the summed basis points of the ranks the group occupies, divided by ten thousand

split.base_share: the group amount divided by the member count, discarding the remainder
split.remainder: one cent to each member in ascending player identifier order until the remainder is exhausted

eligibility.rule: a player whose tournament penalty units reach the disqualify_units clause is not eligible
eligibility.forfeit: the share of an ineligible member is added to the residue and is never redistributed

residue.rule: the pool less every awarded cent
